items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I heard that band. ... Walter Vaughn's band.

ctx.x: Did you know Walter Vaughn's up there? Yes, I did. He had a good band. I had some records by him. Yeah, my people got big business in Mississippi. I heard that band. The same thing happened to them. They all burned up in a fire except for one band. That's it. That's it. That way, in the rhythm. Who was there? Walter Vaughn's band. Yes. Just like that same deal. They were trying and they all got burned up.
They just had come from play and dance here. Mm-hmm. They was on the way. They went there to play the dance.
